title: Edge-index readiness fence stays down after publishes on large graphs, failing provenance export with edge_index_warming
wanted_capability: Provenance export and every other complete_code_read_view consumer should recover after a code-source publish without waiting for an unrelated sidecar change. Every selector-changing publish (code_source.rs and file_source_activation.rs) lowers edge_index_ready and nudges the watcher; only a watcher rebuild raises it again (routes.rs). should_rebuild_edge_index refuses a nudge-only rebuild when the published graph exceeds BLACKBOX_EDGE_INDEX_NUDGE_MAX_CURRENT_EDGES (default 250,000) and sidecar authority did not change. The production graph has about 1.4 million published edges, so after each collector pass the fence stays down, the watcher records store_refresh_deferred, and the provenance lane returns 503 edge_index_warming for every project until some sidecar changes. The collector log shows this daily since the deferral limit landed. Wanted: either the deferral path re-raises the fence on the prior complete view (or the readiness fence is lowered only when a rebuild is actually scheduled), or the nudge limit scales with measured rebuild cost (a full rebuild of this graph takes about 11 seconds, well within budget).
missing_primitive: readiness-fence semantics that distinguish "rebuild deferred, prior view still complete" from "rebuild in progress"
fallback_used: Operator-side knob available: set BLACKBOX_EDGE_INDEX_NUDGE_MAX_CURRENT_EDGES above the published edge count in the cage deployment env so nudges rebuild (about 11 seconds each).
evidence: src/server/code_source.rs republish_code_read_view installs EdgeIndex::default() and lowers edge_index_ready
src/server/git_source.rs provenance_export_page maps the readiness error to HttpError::edge_index_warming
notes: Triage trace: the described mechanism does not reproduce from current code. Every fence-lowering publish (code_source.rs republish_code_read_view and activation sites, file_source_activation.rs) installs an empty EdgeIndex placeholder, so the watcher reads published_edge_count=0 and admits the nudged rebuild; the manifest change also flips sidecars_changed. The deferral branch only runs with the fence already up. The observed edge_index_warming stall is real but its root cause is unconfirmed. Covered together with gap-7da04b93 by one issue on readiness-fence semantics: consumers must recover after every publish within one rebuild.
resolution_note: Obviated by removal of the daemon's in-memory edge graph in commit 39475a94. The readiness fence and nudge-deferral mechanism no longer exist. The original deferral diagnosis had already been unconfirmed on code inspection; this resolution does not affirm that diagnosis. Existing tracking: https://github.com/daystrom-institute/blackbox/issues/44. Verified against accepted beta commit 93c2d391a8d6b8d2d760b88b1acdadbafc7a3ea4.
